name: kafkaforge
description: A distributed event streaming platform inspired by Kafka, built entirely in TypeScript using Node.js

scripts.clean: if exist dist rmdir /s /q dist & exit /b 0 || exit /b 0
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && node --test --experimental-test-coverage dist/tests/unit/config/config.test.js dist/tests/unit/errors/errors.test.js dist/tests/unit/logging/logger.test.js dist/tests/unit/utils/id.test.js dist/tests/unit/utils/time.test.js dist/tests/unit/lifecycle/lifecycle.test.js dist/tests/unit/broker/broker.test.js dist/tests/integration/application/lifecycle.test.js
scripts.lint:check: echo 'Manual linting via TypeScript strict mode'
